title: 第十章 不识抬举的东西！
content_zh:
大明宫中——
「难不成，让朕坐视彼等鞑虏肆虐州县，屠杀朕治下子民！」崇平帝沉喝道。
内阁首辅杨国昌，沉吟了下，开口道：「彼等南下，所图者，不过为取些财货，最多旬月，自会引兵而返。」
这一句，相当于让这些强盗劫掠个够，从容而走。
崇平帝冷笑一声，道：「好一个引兵而返！只是你想做严嵩待敌自走，朕还不想做前明之嘉靖自焚奉天殿！」
「老臣不敢！」杨国昌闻言，脸色剧变，连忙跪下请罪。
崇平帝冷冷看了一眼下方跪伏于地的杨国昌，面色阴沉，道：「兵部。」
武英殿大学士丶兵部尚书李瓒，拱手道：「陛下，微臣在。」
这是一个四十出头，颌下蓄着胡须的中年官员，其人面对盛怒中崇平帝垂询，面色从容，不见慌乱。
「河北丶山东诸卫，最快多久可整军北上相援？」崇平帝目光咄咄，看着兵部尚书李瓒，问道。
李瓒沉声道：「微臣已发函给河北提督康鸿及山东提督陆琪，河北敢战之兵有着十万，可就近而援，山东诸卫之兵，可抽调十万，恐需半月之期。」
国家兵制败坏，这二十万兵马能有多少实额，有多少战力，他也不敢保证，但若只是逐三万鞑子出山海关，兵力应是足够的。
「康鸿的十万兵马在保定府，驰援不难，朝夕可至……倒是山东卫所之兵不是有二十六万人，如何才出这麽一点兵马？」崇平帝皱眉问道。
自辽东失守，陈汉除却在蓟镇屯驻重兵外，更于山东丶河南丶山西三省都司之上设提督军职，经略一省兵务，司掌备寇缉盗，时人尊称为经略使。
李瓒解释道：「近年来，山东十地九旱，尤其今夏数月不雨，赤地千里，田亩歉收，就有白莲教妖人趁势聚民为乱，彼等贼寇攻破县城，杀官造反，山东都司麾下各卫所，于各州县剿匪缉盗，可谓烽火四起，处处用兵，如今能抽调出十二万兵，已是陆琪左支右拙，苦心经营了。」
崇平帝叹了一口气，山东大旱赈灾，他是知道的，摆了摆手，说道：「此事先这般办吧。」
至于京中十二团营，都中一个人都没有提出提调京畿三辅之兵，没有近二十万精锐镇守，庙堂衮衮诸公睡觉都睡不踏实。
山东贼寇作乱，陕西又何尝不是？只是京畿三辅得重兵翼护，匪患随时可清剿，局势尚在掌控。
崇平帝看着跪着的内阁首辅杨国昌，心中的火气也渐消了大半，叹道：「杨爱卿也起来吧，地上凉。」
「谢陛下。」杨国昌颤声说着，但一时没有起身，手持象牙玉笏，苍声道：「臣已近垂暮之年，自觉老迈昏庸，精力不济，于政事愈发不得力，上不能为君父分忧，下不能抚民镇边，臣请乞骸骨。」

崇平帝一时默然，须臾，开口道：「如今国事艰难，正当我君臣戮力同心，同舟共济之时，杨阁老岂忍弃朕而去？」
杨国昌留在朝堂，比起前任首辅，还能为国库弄到银子，用以边防丶剿匪丶备寇糜费，其一去，银子又从哪里来？
杨国昌再请，而老神在在丶眼睑微垂，好似睡着的内阁次辅韩癀，整了整神色，看了一眼崇平帝，在一旁拉起杨国昌的胳膊，温声道：「阁老，陛下忧心边事，一时情切，阁老自责之情，我等皆知，然唯今国势艰难，须臾离不得阁老主持大局，阁老还要体谅陛下，顾全大局才是啊。」
杨国昌被韩癀扶起，然而听着韩癀「温言」，心头却一寒，看向上首脸色晦暗不明的崇平帝，颤声道：「国事唯艰，老臣纵是拼着这一把老骨头，也要为君父排忧解难。」
而在大明宫，大汉君臣为鞑虏犯边，紧急商议对策时——
神京城，宁荣街，柳条儿胡同，贾珩刚刚洗去了一身酒气，换了一身常衫，在东窗下的宣纸上，勾勒着大汉南北一十三省的舆图。
「陈汉承朱明，自然接收了朱明的疆域，后来经国朝百年，辽东又崛起了建州女真，二十五年前夺辽东，建国号为金，自此陈汉全面转入战略防御期，边疆局势基本就是个大号的北宋，或比北宋好一些的是，国都定于长安，幽云未失。」
贾珩看着宣纸之上的地图，这是结合这二日谢再义与他提及的边关形势，绘制而出。
「前明圣人王守仁曾言，大明虽大，紧要之地，也不过四处，若四地失守，大明必亡，所谓四地，即宣大蓟辽。如今的陈汉已丢了辽东，只余蓟州一地，唯幸在于陈汉都城定于长安，纵鞑虏入关，尚可偏安蜀中，但结合着前世南明小朝廷，也不是太保险。」
自从和谢再义这二日闲聊后，再加上对此世史书的研读，贾珩几乎可以断定，这方红楼世界就处在一方乱世前夕。
红楼梦中的探春和亲，陈汉连西海沿子的番国都打不赢，这国力丶军力该衰弱到何等地步？
从此就可窥得一二了。
「太平日子也就十馀年，那时，不仅贾府大厦倾颓，就连这家国也要沦丧于异族之手，青枫林下鬼吟哦，白骨如山忘姓氏……我华夏神器将为异族所窃据。」
贾珩深深吐出一口浊气。
如果他不想十馀年后的乱世如草芥一般死去，就要提前做好筹谋。
「不过，眼下还需过得贾珍父子这一关。」
铺着羊毛地毯的花厅中，贾珍听完贾蓉禀告，脸色阴沉，冷声道：「他真是这般说的？」
「孩儿哪敢瞒着老爷，那贾珩说，纵是黄金万两，他也不会退婚！」贾蓉愤愤道。
「好一个贾珩，真是好胆！」贾珍冷哼一声，拍了拍小几，震动得其上盏碟乱起。
他为贾家族长以来，除却西府的主子，这两府的五服之亲还真没有敢这般违逆于他的。

不识抬举的东西！
一旁娴静而坐，姿容美艳的妇人，年岁在三十许，云鬓挽成妇人发髻，露出光洁如玉的额头，金色步摇在烛火下熠熠闪过，一身作工精美丶用料考究的黄褐色罗裙，将丰腴有致的身段尽显。
美妇五官精致，白里透红的脸颊，娇艳明媚似二月桃花，琼鼻娇小玲珑，鼻梁挺直，饱满莹润的樱唇涂着淡淡胭脂，白皙修长的脖颈儿下，双峰秀挺，形似满月，嫣然一笑道：「老爷，何必生这般大的气？若是那贾珩不许，再为蓉儿另寻一门好的……」
「你知道什麽！」贾珍根本不等尤氏说完，面沉似水，就是冷喝一声，打断了话头，训斥道：「蓉儿这个不成器的！平日里一味寻花问柳，飞鹰走狗，哪家公侯小姐能看得上他！这是我好不容易为他寻得一门好亲事，岂容那穷措大坏事！」
听着贾珍训斥，尤氏娇躯颤了下，双手捏紧了手中粉红色绣帕，抿了抿朱唇，不敢多言语。
多年夫妻，她自是知道贾珍这是动了真怒。
贾珍将一双阴鸷的目光，猛地投向吓得鹌鹑一般的贾蓉，冷声道：「蓉儿，明日你将这贾珩寻来，我亲自会会他，看看他眼里还有没有我这个族长！」

content_en:
In the Daming Palace——
"Is it possible for me to sit back and watch those Tartars ravage the prefectures and counties and massacre the people under my rule!" Emperor Chongping shouted.
Yang Guochang, the chief minister of the cabinet, pondered for a moment and then said: "Their goal of going south is just to get some goods. At most, they will lead their troops back in ten months."
This sentence is equivalent to letting these robbers plunder enough and leave calmly.
Emperor Chongping sneered and said: "What a leader to lead the troops back! But if you want to be Yan Song and wait for the enemy to leave, I don't want to do what Jiajing did in the previous Ming Dynasty and burn himself to the Fengtian Palace!"
"I don't dare!" Upon hearing this, Yang Guochang's face changed drastically and he knelt down to apologize.
Emperor Chongping glanced coldly at Yang Guochang, who was kneeling on the ground below, with a gloomy face and said: "The Ministry of War."
Li Zan, the great scholar of Wuyingdian and Minister of War, cupped his hands and said, "Your Majesty, I am here."
This is a middle-aged official in his early forties with a beard under his chin. When faced with the enraged Emperor Chongping's inquiries, he looked calm and showed no signs of panic.
"How soon will it be possible for the guards in Hebei and Shandong to mobilize their troops and march north to support each other?" Emperor Chongping asked, looking at Li Zan, Minister of War, with an eager look.
Li Zan said solemnly: "Wei Chen has sent a letter to the Hebei Admiral Kang Hong and the Shandong Admiral Lu Qi. There are 100,000 soldiers in Hebei who dare to fight. They can be nearby for reinforcements. The soldiers of the Shandong guards can mobilize 100,000 soldiers. It may take half a month."
The country's military system was in ruins. He could not guarantee the actual number and combat strength of these 200,000 troops. However, if he only drove 30,000 Tatars out of Shanhaiguan, the strength should be sufficient.
"Kang Hong's 100,000 soldiers and horses are in Baoding Mansion. It's not difficult to rush for reinforcements. They can arrive day and night... But there are not 260,000 soldiers in the Shandong Guard Station. How can we have such a small number of soldiers and horses?" Emperor Chongping asked with a frown.
Since the fall of Liaodong, Chen Han not only garrisoned heavy troops in Jizhen, but also set up the post of military admiral above the capitals of Shandong, Henan, and Shanxi provinces. He was responsible for overseeing the military affairs of a province and being in charge of preparing for bandits and arresting bandits. People at that time respectfully called him the military envoy.
Li Zan explained: "In recent years, there have been nine droughts out of ten places in Shandong. Especially this summer, there has been no rain for several months. The land has been bare for thousands of miles and the fields have failed to harvest. The demons of the White Lotus Sect took advantage of the situation and gathered the people to cause chaos. These thieves broke into the county and killed everyone. The officials rebelled, and the guards under the command of the Shandong Dusi went to suppress bandits and arrest thieves in various states and counties. It can be said that war was everywhere, and troops were used everywhere. Now that we can mobilize 120,000 troops, it is Lu Qi's hard work. "
Emperor Chongping sighed. He knew about the drought relief in Shandong. He waved his hand and said, "Let's do this in advance."
As for the 12 regiments and camps in the capital, no one in the capital proposed to raise the troops of the three auxiliaries of the capital. Without nearly 200,000 elite guards, the princes in the temples and temples could not sleep well.
Bandits are causing chaos in Shandong, so why not Shaanxi? It's just that the Third Auxiliary of Gyeonggi Province is heavily protected by troops, bandits can be eliminated at any time, and the situation is still under control.
Emperor Chongping looked at Yang Guochang, the kneeling chief minister of the cabinet, and the anger in his heart gradually subsided. He sighed: "Yang Aiqing, please get up too, the ground is cold."
"Thank you, Your Majesty." Yang Guochang said in a trembling voice, but did not stand up for a moment. Holding an ivory jade wat, he said in a green voice: "I am nearing my twilight years. I feel that I am old and feeble, and my energy is low. I am becoming more and more ineffective in political affairs. I am unable to share the worries of the emperor and father, and I am unable to care for the people and towns. I am begging for my bones."
Emperor Chongping was silent for a moment, then he spoke: "Nowadays, the country is in a difficult situation. When my ruler and ministers are working together to help each other, how can Mr. Yangge bear to abandon me?"
If Yang Guochang stayed in the court, he could get more money for the treasury than his predecessor as chief minister, which could be used for border defense, suppressing bandits, and preventing bandits from spending money. Once he was gone, where would the money come from?
Yang Guochang invited again, but the old man was there with his eyelids slightly drooped, like Han Huang, the sleeping deputy minister of the cabinet. He straightened his expression, glanced at Emperor Chongping, took Yang Guochang's arm and said warmly: "Mr. Pavilion, Your Majesty is worried about the affairs at hand. We all know how much you blame yourself. However, the current country is in a difficult situation, and you will not be able to preside over the overall situation for a moment. You must also be considerate of your Majesty."Come on, just take the overall situation into consideration. "
Yang Guochang was helped up by Han Huang, but when he heard Han Huang's "warm words", he felt a chill in his heart. He looked at Emperor Chongping, who looked up at him with a gloomy expression, and said in a trembling voice: "The affairs of the country are very difficult. Even if I am struggling with my old bones, I still have to solve the problems for my father."
In the Daming Palace, the Han monarchs and ministers invaded the border for the Tartars and urgently discussed countermeasures——
In the sacred city of Ningrong Street and Liutiaoer Alley, Jia Heng had just washed away the smell of alcohol and changed into a regular shirt. On the rice paper under the east window, he sketched a map of the thirteen provinces of the Han Dynasty in the north and south.
"Chen Han succeeded Zhu Ming and naturally took over Zhu Ming's territory. Later, after a hundred years of dynasty, the Jianzhou Jurchens emerged in Liaodong. They captured Liaodong twenty-five years ago and the founding title was Jin. Since then, Chen Han has fully entered the strategic defense period. The border situation is basically that of the Northern Song Dynasty. Or better than the Northern Song Dynasty. The capital of the country is Chang'an, and Youyun has not been lost."
Jia Heng looked at the map on the rice paper, which was drawn based on the border situation mentioned by Xie Zaiyi and him in the past two days.
"The sage Wang Shouren of the former Ming Dynasty once said that although the Ming Dynasty was big, there were only four important places. If the four places were lost, the Ming Dynasty would be destroyed. The so-called four places were known as Ji Liao. Today, the Chen and Han Dynasties have lost Liaodong, and only Jizhou is left. Fortunately, the capital of the Chen and Han Dynasties was set in Chang'an, and even with the Tatars entering the pass, it was still safe in Shuzhong, but combined with the small court of the Southern Ming Dynasty in the previous life, it was not too safe."
After chatting with Xie Zaiyi for the past two days, coupled with the study of the history books of this world, Jia Heng can almost conclude that the world of Red Mansion is on the eve of chaos.
In the Tanchun marriage in Dream of Red Mansions, Chen Han could not even defeat the foreign countries along the Western Sea. How weak should this national and military power be?
From now on you can get a glimpse of it.
"The days of peace will only last for more than ten years. At that time, not only will the Jia Mansion be in ruins, but also this country will be lost to the hands of foreigners. Ghosts will be singing under the green maple forest, and bones will be as white as mountains. Forgot your surname... My Chinese artifact will be stolen by foreigners."
Jia Heng exhaled a deep breath.
If he doesn't want to die like a fool in the troubled times more than ten years later, he must make plans in advance.
"However, we still need to pass the test of Jia Zhen and his son."
In the flower hall covered with wool carpets, after listening to Jia Rong's report, Jia Zhen looked gloomy and said coldly: "Did he really say that?"
"How dare the child hide this from the master? Jia Heng said that even if it cost him ten thousand taels of gold, he would not break off the engagement!" Jia Rong said angrily.
"What a brave Jia Heng!" Jia Zhen snorted coldly and patted the small table, which was so shaken that the dishes on it shook.
Since he became the head of the Jia family, except for the master of the Xifu, no one of the five relatives of the two houses dared to disobey him like this.
Things that don’t know how to praise!
Sitting quietly aside, a beautiful woman in her thirties, with her temples pulled up into a womanly bun, revealing her smooth and jade-like forehead, her golden steps flashing under the candlelight, wearing a tawny skirt with exquisite workmanship and exquisite materials, showing off her plump and graceful figure.
The beautiful woman has delicate facial features, rosy cheeks, as bright and beautiful as peach blossoms in February, a petite nose with a straight bridge, and plump and moist cherry lips with a light rouge. Under her fair and slender neck, her breasts look like a full moon. She smiled sweetly and said, "Master, why are you so angry? If Jia Heng doesn't allow it, then find another good job for Ronger..."
"What do you know!" Jia Zhen didn't wait for Youshi to finish, her face was as heavy as water, she just shouted coldly, interrupted the conversation, and reprimanded: "Rong'er is useless! On weekdays, he just blindly looks for flowers and willows, flying eagles and lackeys, which prince and lady can like him! This is how I finally found a good marriage for him, how can I tolerate such a bad thing!"
Listening to Jia Zhen's scolding, Youshi's delicate body trembled, she squeezed the pink embroidered handkerchief in her hands tightly, pursed her red lips, and did not dare to say anything.
After being married for many years, she knew that Jia Zhen was really angry.
Jia Zhen cast a pair of sinister eyes,He suddenly threw himself at Jia Rong, who was as frightened as a quail, and said in a cold voice: "Rong'er, you will find Jia Heng here tomorrow, and I will meet him personally to see if he still sees me as the clan leader!"
